description: This file defines a custom WPF control named OperatorPanelListView, which extends ListView to include custom scrolling behavior with left and right arrow buttons, handling pointer events and view changes.

classes.name: OperatorPanelListView
classes.description: A custom ListView control with integrated scroll buttons and pointer event handling for a specialized operator panel.

methods.name: OperatorPanelListView
methods.description: Constructor for the custom list view control.

methods.name: OnApplyTemplate
methods.description: Overrides the method to initialize template parts and attach event handlers.

methods.name: OnScrollClick
methods.description: Handles click events on scroll buttons to scroll left or right.

methods.name: OnPointerEntered
methods.description: Handles pointer entering the control, updating scroll button visibility if the pointer is a mouse.

methods.name: OnPointerExited
methods.description: Handles pointer exiting the control, hiding scroll buttons.

methods.name: OnButtonPointerExited
methods.description: Handles pointer exiting individual scroll buttons, preventing event bubbling if the button is not visible.

methods.name: ScrollViewChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in the scroll view to update button visibility.

methods.name: ShowHideScrollButtons
methods.description: Sets the visibility of the scroll left and right buttons.

methods.name: UpdateScrollButtons
methods.description: Updates the visibility of scroll buttons based on current scroll position and content size.

methods.name: ScrollLeft
methods.description: Scrolls the view to the left by a ratio of the viewport width.

methods.name: ScrollRight
methods.description: Scrolls the view to the right by a ratio of the viewport width.
